newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff, Career Horizons to merge.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff, Career Horizons to merge.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc and Career Horizons Inc said Monday they signed a definitive merger agreement in a deal valued at an estimated $1 billion.
Under the agreement, Career Horizons stockholders will receive 1.53 shares of AccuStaff stock for each share owned of Career Horizons stock.
Based on AccuStaff's $28-per-share closing price as of Friday, the transaction is valued at about $1 billion, the companies said in a statement.
Under the agreement, the exchange ratio is subject to adjustment, but the minimum ratio will be 1.2444 and the maximum is set at 1.8006, the company said.

The transaction has been unanimously approved by the boards of directors at both companies. The deal is expected to be closed during this year's fourth quarter. The transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests and will be a tax-free reorganization, the companies said.

"We expect the merger to be accretive to AccuStaff's earnings for the first full year of combined operations and we believe it will also add significant long-term value to our shareholders," AccuStaff Chairman, President and Chief Executive Derek Dewan said in a statement.

AccuStaff's Dewan will remain as chairman, president and chief executive following the merger. Career Horizon's President and Chief Executive Walter Macauley will join AccuStaff's board of directors as vice chairman.

The new company, operating as AccuStaff Inc, will provide staffing, consulting and outsourcing services. It will have more than 750 offices in 43 states and combined annual estimated 1996 revenues in excess of $1.3 billion.
Estimated combined revenues for 1997, exclusive of future acquisitions, are projected to be in excess of $1.7 billion.
The merger will create the fourth largest staffing company in the United States.
